name: Fall STEM Innovators: Robotics & 3D Design/Printing
description: Thunder Hill's after-school tech club — a 6-week STEM program. Build & program cool robots, and design & print in 3D!
registration_note: Or scan the QR code on the flyer.

name: KidzArt at Thunder Hill
description: A fun art-enrichment program designed to build drawing skills and confidence. Certified instructors guide students through original works using artist-grade materials — oil and chalk pastels, watercolor, charcoal, clay, and more. Projects never repeat.
date_range: Runs in 5 sessions across the school year (see below)
registration_note: Register for any session securely online, then click “Register Now.”

name: Disney's The Lion King JR
description: Thunder Hill Elementary's after-school theatre program, staging Disney's The Lion King JR. If any family is interested in the play but the cost is a concern, CCTA does offer scholarship opportunities for families who need financial assistance — apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdBvYop8bx0PykyVOSV2rMj3mljxA84ESaOmobtF45rh-SjyA/viewform. CCTA can be reached at 410-381-0700 or admin@cctarts.org — they're happy to answer questions and help families learn more about available assistance.
date_range: Oct 20, Oct 27, Nov 10, Nov 17, Dec 1, Dec 8, Dec 15, Dec 22, Jan 5, Jan 12 (no class 11/3, 11/24, 1/19)

name: Chess Wizards
description: Challenging chess lessons, fun group activities, and exciting tournaments. Brand-new players and seasoned checkmate artists both welcome — kindergartners and new chess players welcome!
registration_note: Or scan the QR code on the flyer to register.

name: Girls on the Run
provider: Girls on the Run Central Maryland
description: A physical-activity-based program that builds girls' confidence, kindness, and decision-making skills through a running-focused curriculum, culminating in a celebratory 5K. Coming soon to Thunder Hill — the PTA is reserving space for this program.
registration_note: Details (schedule, price, registration) coming soon — check back or contact the PTA for updates.

name: Chess Club Before School
provider: Silver Knights Chess Academy (Howard County Recreation & Parks)
description: All skill levels welcome! Silver Knights has taught 10,000+ children to play chess in Howard County, including state champions — though most students are beginners. Class time splits between lessons and practice games, from basic rules to advanced tournament strategies, with chances to play in tournaments. All chess supplies provided.
registration_note: This information is neither sponsored nor endorsed by HCPSS or the school.

name: Spanish After School
provider: International School of Languages (Howard County Recreation & Parks)
description: A well-rounded program to learn and improve Spanish — greetings, the alphabet, numbers, colors, shapes, animals, and more, through conversation, music, flashcards, games, videos, art, and storybooks. Fee includes online resources for continued practice at home.
registration_note: This information is neither sponsored nor endorsed by HCPSS or the school.

name: Music & Theater Arts: Beginner Ensemble
provider: Learn Now Music (Howard County Recreation & Parks)
description: It's teamwork, with a beat! Budding musicians play as a band while learning collaboration, timing, and performance skills — choose drums, guitar, piano, violin, or ukulele at registration. Fee includes a rental instrument and required curriculum; instruments and music go home between classes. A signed rental agreement is required, and families are responsible for the return cost of any unreturned or damaged instrument.
registration_note: This information is neither sponsored nor endorsed by HCPSS or the school.

name: Aurora STEAM Innovation Lab After School
description: "Create & Explore!" — hands-on STEAM exploration introducing science, technology, engineering, art, and math. Explore coding with Scratch or Scratch Jr, build and program LEGO® Spike Essentials and Prime robots, run science experiments, design simple machines and circuits, and create STEAM-based art and digital projects. A brief assessment tailors the experience for both new and returning students.
registration_note: This information is neither sponsored nor endorsed by HCPSS or the school.

name: After-School Basketball with Amazing Athletes
description: Master ball handling, shooting, passing, and game rules at your own pace, with friendly scrimmages that build teamwork and sportsmanship. Each class includes warm-ups, an activation game, three sport-specific skills, a scrimmage, and a cooldown — great whether you're brand-new or already play.
registration_note: This information is neither sponsored nor endorsed by HCPSS or the school.

name: After School Running with Little & Junior TrackStars
provider: Little & Junior TrackStars (Howard County Recreation & Parks)
description: Build fundamental athletic skills through running, jumping, and mental-focus drills — refining gross motor skills, balance, coordination, speed, and agility through interactive drills, games, and friendly competitive racing. All experience levels welcome.
registration_note: This information is neither sponsored nor endorsed by HCPSS or the school.

name: Cub Scouts Pack 838
description: Back to Scouting Night — come learn about Pack 838's activities, including camping, the Pinewood Derby, community service, and more. Open to boys and girls in grades K–5.
day_time: Back to Scouting Night: Wed, Sept 16, 6:30–8:00 PM
registration_note: Scan the QR code on the flyer to join, or email Torey to learn more.

name: Girl Scouts Troop 4709
description: Troop 4709 is looking for girls in grades K–3 (Daisies & Brownies) to join for the 2026–2027 school year. Activities include selling cookies, caroling/volunteering, rollerskating, hands-on crafts, and nature/outdoor activities. Camping is optional.
contact: Troop Leader Emi Henley — emikhenley@mail.com (not Gmail)
